heading.en: Why does oxygen need more heat than helium?

hook.en: Warm one mole of helium and one mole of oxygen by one degree at constant volume. Oxygen takes about two-thirds more heat, because its molecules can also spin.
hook.kn: ಒಂದು ಮೋಲ್ ಹೀಲಿಯಮ್ ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ಮೋಲ್ ಆಕ್ಸಿಜನ್ ಅನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಿರ ಗಾತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಡಿಗ್ರಿ ಬಿಸಿಮಾಡಿ. ಆಕ್ಸಿಜನ್ ಅಣುಗಳು ತಿರುಗಲೂ ಬಲ್ಲವು, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಉಷ್ಣ ಬೇಕು.

objectives.en: Predict Cv, Cp and γ for gases and solids

narration.en: Warm one mole of helium and one mole of oxygen by one degree at constant volume. Oxygen takes about two-thirds more heat, because its molecules can also spin.
narration.kn: ಒಂದು ಮೋಲ್ ಹೀಲಿಯಮ್ ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ಮೋಲ್ ಆಕ್ಸಿಜನ್ ಅನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಿರ ಗಾತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಡಿಗ್ರಿ ಬಿಸಿಮಾಡಿ. ಆಕ್ಸಿಜನ್ ಅಣುಗಳು ತಿರುಗಲೂ ಬಲ್ಲವು, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಉಷ್ಣ ಬೇಕು.

body.en: Each independent way a molecule can store energy as a squared term is a degree of freedom. Law of equipartition: in thermal equilibrium at temperature T, each such term has an average energy of ½k_BT. A monatomic molecule has 3 (translational); a rigid diatomic molecule has 5 (3 translational + 2 rotational); a vibrating diatomic adds 2 more terms (kinetic and potential energy of vibration).
body.kn: ಅಣು ಶಕ್ತಿ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುವ ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ವಿಧಗಳೇ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯದ ಮಾತ್ರೆಗಳು. ಸಮವಿಭಜನೆ ನಿಯಮ: ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದಕ್ಕೂ ಸರಾಸರಿ ½k_BT ಶಕ್ತಿ. ಏಕಪರಮಾಣು ಅಣುವಿಗೆ 3, ದೃಢ ದ್ವಿಪರಮಾಣು ಅಣುವಿಗೆ 5.

narration.en: Each independent way a molecule can store energy as a squared term is a degree of freedom. Law of equipartition: in thermal equilibrium at temperature T, each such term has an average energy of ½k_BT. A monatomic molecule has 3 (translational); a rigid diatomic molecule has 5 (3 translational + 2 rotational); a vibrating diatomic adds 2 more terms (kinetic and potential energy of vibration).
narration.kn: ಅಣು ಶಕ್ತಿ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುವ ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ವಿಧಗಳೇ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯದ ಮಾತ್ರೆಗಳು. ಸಮವಿಭಜನೆ ನಿಯಮ: ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದಕ್ಕೂ ಸರಾಸರಿ ½k_BT ಶಕ್ತಿ. ಏಕಪರಮಾಣು ಅಣುವಿಗೆ 3, ದೃಢ ದ್ವಿಪರಮಾಣು ಅಣುವಿಗೆ 5.

say.en: A single atom can move along x, y and z: three translational degrees of freedom.
A rigid diatomic molecule also rotates about two axes perpendicular to its bond: f = 5. At high temperature vibration adds two more.
Equipartition: in equilibrium, each squared energy term holds on average one half k_B T.
For one mole, U is f over 2 R T. So C_v = f R over 2, C_p = C_v + R, and gamma = 1 + 2 over f.
Monatomic: gamma five thirds. Rigid diatomic: seven fifths. Non-linear polyatomic, f = 6: four thirds.
In a solid each atom vibrates in three directions, with kinetic and potential terms: 3 R, about 25 joule per mole kelvin. That is the Dulong–Petit law.

So C_v = f R over 2, C_p = C_v + R, and gamma = 1 + 2 over f. Monatomic: gamma five thirds. Rigid diatomic: seven fifths. Non-linear polyatomic, f = 6: four thirds. title.en: Sharing energy among degrees of freedom

narration.en: Each degree of freedom gets ½kT of energy on average (½kT for each way of moving; a vibration has two shares, one kinetic and one potential). More shares means more energy per kelvin, so Cv = (f/2)R and γ = 1 + 2/f.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಮಟ್ಟಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಾಸರಿ ½kT ಶಕ್ತಿ (ಕಂಪನಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡು ಪಾಲು: ಚಲನ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಿತಿ). ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪಾಲುಗಳಾದರೆ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕೆಲ್ವಿನ್‌ಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಶಕ್ತಿ: Cv = (f/2)R, γ = 1 + 2/f.

title.en: Specific heats of gases and solids

body.en: For one mole with f degrees of freedom, U = (f/2)RT, so Cv = (f/2)R, Cp = Cv + R and γ = 1 + 2/f. Monatomic: Cv = 3R/2, γ = 5/3. Rigid diatomic: Cv = 5R/2, γ = 7/5. Rigid non-linear polyatomic: f = 6, γ = 4/3. For a solid each atom oscillates in 3 directions with kinetic and potential energy, giving C = 3R (Dulong–Petit law).
body.kn: ಒಂದು ಮೋಲ್‌ಗೆ Cv = (f/2)R, Cp = Cv + R, γ = 1 + 2/f. ಏಕಪರಮಾಣು γ = 5/3, ದ್ವಿಪರಮಾಣು γ = 7/5. ಘನಗಳಿಗೆ C = 3R (ಡ್ಯೂಲಾಂಗ್–ಪೆಟಿಟ್ ನಿಯಮ).

narration.en: For one mole with f degrees of freedom, U = (f/2)RT, so Cv = (f/2)R, Cp = Cv + R and γ = 1 + 2/f. Monatomic: Cv = 3R/2, γ = 5/3. Rigid diatomic: Cv = 5R/2, γ = 7/5. Rigid non-linear polyatomic: f = 6, γ = 4/3. For a solid each atom oscillates in 3 directions with kinetic and potential energy, giving C = 3R (Dulong–Petit law).
